tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i bla ri dang bla mtsho bsam brling phu na bzhugs pa la gnas pa' ིsman rgyal ma gnyis la gsol mchod bya tshul ci bsam lhun grub bzhugs so/ /gangs 'di la yig rnying phal cher du stag 'tsher zhes pa ra ra btags su 'dug kyang kho bo'i go don la ni lung pa 'di'i ri mtho shos yin pas nyi ma 'char nub gnyis ka'i 'od zer thog mthar rtag tu 'tsher bas ra btags yin nam snyam nas gsol mchod 'dir yang de bzhin bris pa'o// oṃ swasti/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bla ri dang / bla mtshor grags pa/ rtag 'tsher gangs kyi rgyal mo dang / mtsho sman 'dod dgu'i rgyal mo gnyis lhan cig tu gsol mchod bya tshul ni/ phye phud gtsang ma dmar skyur sogs 'bag btsog ngan pas ma bslad par bum rdzas nyer lnga dang / klu sman dkar gsum sogs kha zas bzang po gtsang ma sne 'dzoms bsres la/ li lcags dug shing bse ma yin pa'i snod ji ltar rigs par zlum gtor pad ma'i snying po can ril bu brgya rtsas gsum cha nub pa la mar rgyan ci mdzes dang dar sna lnga'am dkar ser gang rung gis brgyan pa'i mthar shing 'bras sogs kha zas sna tshogs spungs/ de yi nye skor du phye mar 'bras chan zho 'o ma gang rung gi dkar phud g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang ma rnams dkar yol sogs snod gas chag med par bshams/ mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang bsangs shing sna tshogs kyi dud pa sbyar/ dar mdung ba dan mda' dar sogs mang du 'phyar/ rang gtsang sbra la gnas pa'i drung rdor dril 'thor snod rol sil rnga dung sogs bshams la/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i sogs rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms mdun bskyed sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor ci rigs dang / bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol gyi tshig dang /

sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs sems bskyed kyi tshig rnams gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o/ /rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes lan gsum gyi rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shu n+ya tās bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dar sngon pos stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can nas dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim par bsam/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/

gong ltar mchod/ de rnams kyi oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim par bsam zhing / oṃ nī laṃ ba ra rda ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces ci nus bsgrang mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ yang mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin la dharmā ra ṇi sogs mi dgos/ gtor ma mthun rdzas spyan gzigs rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dang / mthun rdzas rnams khaṃ dkar po zhu ba las byung ba'i lha yi zhal zas bza' bca' btung ba ri dang rgya mtsho lta bu kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang spyan gzigs rnams lha rdzas kyi yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ gtor ma mthun rdzas rnams kyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim pa bzhin du brtsegs pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum yi ge gsum zhu nas nyes skyon thams cad dag par gyur/ rdo rje bsdam pa 'debs tshul dang / oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir sgyur/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis dang tha ma bzhi sbyar la bsgreng /

srin mdzub gnyis bsnol/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu bkug pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭhi sid+dhi lo tsa na sarba ar+tha sa dha ni swāhā/ lan gsum/ 'di la 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rnam sras bskang gso na/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bca' bar gsung 'dug kyang / rnam sras yig rnying rnams las spyan ma'i phyag rgya bca' bar bshad pas gong bkod bzhin dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya ni 'dir ma zad rnam sras la'ang zur du bya dgos par sems shing / sngags rgya gnyis po 'dis rgya cher spel/ thal mo khong stong las sor mo dbus ma gsum gyi tshigs bar ma bcag pa'i phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo nas khaṃ swāhā'i bar gsum/ de nas rnga rol dang bcas pa'am yang na rdor dril 'dzin pas/ kyai rgyal ba'i bsti gnas byas 'gyur dpal gyi ri/ /mtho zhing lhun sdug rin chen de yi mtha'/ /ri phran bkra shis rtags brgyad gnas pa la/ /rin chen gdugs mdzes lta bu'i gangs ri ni/ /rtag 'tsher gangs kyi rgyal mor mtshan gsol ba/ /rtse mo dgung sngon yangs par 'phyo 'dra la/ /nyi zla gza' skar 'ja' sprin lding zhing 'khor/ /sked pa g.ya' spang rin chen margad dang / /in+d+ra nī le'i phung po brdal ba la/ /spu sdug bya dang ri dwags rtsed 'jo byed/ /rtsa ba sra brtan rdo rje'i brag ri ni/ /dbang chen 'dzin ma'i dbyings nas skyes pa bzhin/ /logs la g.ya' chu gangs chu gsung snyan sgrog /'dod dgu 'khyil ba'i rgya mtsho du ma zhig /baiḍūr sngon po'i khu ba 'khyil 'dra la/ /lbu phreng mu tig dkar po'i tshom bu bzhin/ /ngang ngur snyan pa'i sgra ldan chu bya rnams/ /bag phebs dal gyis rgyu bas 'jug ngogs byed/ /yid 'ong ri dang rgya mtsho de dag gis/ /rnam par spras pa'i dbus su khang bzang ni/ /rin chen las grub sgo dang rta babs dang / /phyi ra khor yug ljongs sogs khyon yangs par/

/gangs dang mtsho sman du ma'i grong khyer dbus/ /khang bzang lha yi grong khyer lta bu'i nang / /bu dang bu mo dar dang rin chen spras/ /bran dang bran mo 'jo sgeg las kun byed/ /'dod yon rnam lnga sprin bzhin 'thibs pa'i dbyings/ /lha rdzas las grub rin chen khri gdan la/ /rtag 'tsher sman gyi rgyal mo sku mdog dkar/ /mtsho sman 'dod dgu'i rgyal mo sku mdog mthing / /gnyis ka mdzes sdug 'dod chags gzhon nu'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis yid bzhin nor bu bsnams/ /rin chen rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes na bza' khri li li/ /gzi brjid nyi zla'i 'od ldem me re re/ /snyan pa'i nga ro'i glu dbyangs kyu ru ru/ /zhim pa'i nged kyi dri bzang thu lu lu/ /dran pa'i mod la dgos 'dod stsol ba yi/ /rtag 'tsher gangs kyi rgyal mo 'khor bcas dang / /mtsho sman 'dod dgu'i rgyal mo 'khor bcas la/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs shing / /lhag bsam rab dkar kun bzang mchod sprin ltar/ /nam mkha' mtha' klas gtor ma rgya chen dang / /phye mar gangs ri spung 'dra dpal gyi zas/ /'bras chan 'bru yi phung po ro bcud ldan/ /dkar phud nad rims bzhi brgya 'joms pa'i sman/ /g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang ma bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bsangs shing dud pas grib dang mi gtsang sel/ /spyan gzigs sna tshogs sprin ltar 'thibs pa 'dis/ /khyed rnams sku gsung thugs kyi gzi brjid bskyed/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /rtag 'tsher gangs kyi rgyal mo gsol lo mchod/ /mtsho sman 'dod dgu'i rgyal mo༞ /sman gnyis bskyed pa'i yab yum༞ /thugs la nye ba'i dbang po༞ /yid du 'ong ba'i sras lcam༞ /brtse zhing dung pa'i mched zla༞ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bran g.yog༞ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i pho nya༞ /stobs 'byor ldan pa'i 'khor 'bangs༞ /rta sogs rkang bzhi'i phyugs rnams༞

/dur sogs 'dab chags bya rnams༞ /ri dwags spu sdug tshogs rnams༞ /sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gsol lo mchod/ /gsol lo mchod do gangs kyi rgyal mo dang / /mtsho sman rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cig /nam mkha'i mdzod kyi longs spyod rgyas༞ /nye bar mkho ba'i༞ /dkar nag phyugs kyi g.yang rnams rgyas gyur cig /thugs kyi bzhed don ma lus 'grub gyur cig /kyai de ltar gsol zhing mchod pa'i nus mthu yis/ /bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i bzhed don mthar phyin nas/ /'jig rten khams kun bde skyid dpal 'byor gyis/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin du rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /khyad par sngon tshe sa skya lo tsā ba/ /byas 'gyur ri bo'i spo la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /rtag 'tsher rgyal mos gangs kyi rtse mo ru/ /lha yi rta pa mngon sum sprul nas kyang / /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i brda' bstan dang / /sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog ngag gi dbang / /kun dga' rin chen gang de'i zhabs drung du/ /rnam sprul du mas zhal bzhes mdzad pa ltar/ /kha'u lung pa'i mi phyugs thams cad dang / /byas 'gyur skyed lhas gong 'og spong ba pa/ /bsam brling gzhung dang dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /lha sde mi sde bcas pa thams cad la/ /nyin mtshan srung skyob bya ra mel tshe mdzod/ /bye brag dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing yun du gnas pa'i phyir/ /'chi med 'khon rigs rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /gdung brgyud dri med lo zla ma 'gyangs par/ /myur du 'byon zhing byon pa de dag kyang / /sangs rgyas byang sems rnam sprul sha stag la/ /mi dang mi min phas rgol gang gis kyang / /tho 'tshams bar chad kun gyis mi tshugs shing / /bdud dang bdud kyi rjes 'brang ji snyed kun/ /skad cig tsam gyis rdul du rlog pa la/

/phyag na rdo rje lta bu'i mthu stobs mdzod/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor legs tshogs rnams/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu rgyas gyur nas/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs gang legs pa/ /de kun bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /lnga bdo'i dus 'dir mi dge shugs drag pas/ /lha klu sde brgyad dregs pa can rnams la/ /mi grib phog pas ljongs 'dir nad mug dang / /'khrug rtsod mi mthun phyogs kun rlung ltar g.yo/ /bde ba'i go skabs bral ba'i skal dman rnams/ /snying nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro na/ /mchog gsum bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /gangs dang mtsho sman mas mtshon dkar phyogs lha'i/ /tshad med thugs rje'i spyan gyis nyer gzigs la/ /mgon med 'gro rnams srung skyob dus la babs/ /de ltar bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rten 'brel zab mo bslu ba med pa dang / /sman rgyal gnyis kyis brtse gdung thugs rje'i mthus/ /re smon thams cad lhun gyis grub par shog /kyai rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs de/ /de ring phywa dang g.yang du byon/ /yi dam dngos grub rnam gnyis de/ /de ring phywa dang༞ /mchog gsum bden pa bslu med de/ /de ring phywa dang༞ /mkha' 'gro chos srung mthu rtsal de/ /de ring༞ /nor lha gter bdag dpal 'byor de/ /de ring phywa dang༞ /bde skyid lha yi lha g.yang de/ /de ring phywa༞ /stobs ldan lha min rtsal g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /klu dang gnod sbyin 'byor g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /dal 'byor mi yi mi g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /rngog chags 'gros kyi 'gros g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /rtsi bcud phyugs kyi phyugs g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /zas 'bru bcud kyi bcud g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /bang mdzod nor gyi nor g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /dge slong khrims ldan btsun g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /sngags pa nus ldan mthu g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /stag shar dpa' bo'i dpa' g.yang de/ /de ring༞

/khrel ldan mdzangs ma'i mdzangs g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /'chi med tshe yi tshe g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /rgas med lang tsho'i 'tsho g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /nad med bde ba'i bde g.yang de/ /de ring༞ /bsod nams ri rgyal lhun po de/ de ring༞ /mi brgyud rin chen bzhi 'dren de/ /de ring༞ /snyan grags nam mkha' khyab pa de/ /de ring༞ /bkra shis kun tu dge ba de/ /de ring phywa dang g.yang du byon/ /de ring hu ye hu ldan no/ /de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no/ /dge legs thams cad deng 'dir byon/ /ci bsam lhun gyis grub pa dang / /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cig /ces brjod la gtor ma mthun rdzas mchod rdzas rnams/ gangs khrod dam/ mtsho'am/ yang na gtsang por gtsang sbra dang ldan pas bskyal/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs dang tshigs bcad mjug gi bzod gsol bya/ brtan bzhugs dang gshegs gsol mi dgos/ gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur nas sogs/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i sogs/ sh+lau ka gnyis/ bla med bla ma'i sogs/ ston mchog dam pa sogs kyi bkra shis bya/ 'di klu gtor dang sbrel nas gtong na/ brgyad tshan rdzogs nas chu sbyin 'gor mchod gtor byin rlabs sogs byas la/ kyai rgyal ba'i bsti gnas nas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cig gi bar/ ting shag dkrol la btang / rgya gar sher bsangs dang sbrel nas gtong na/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag thams cad bsangs/ kyai bsangs so zhes pa'i rjes su/ mchod gtor byin rlabs sogs byas la/ kyai rgyal ba'i bsti gnas la rnga brdung / gsol mchod rdzogs mtshams dang / 'phrin bcol rdzogs mtshams rol mo byas la/ rgya gar sher bsang gi 'phro phywa 'gugs rdzogs pa'i bar btang / de nas 'di yi phywa 'gugs kyi mthar rol mo bya/ 'di rang rkyang pa gtong na gong bkod ji lta ba bzhin no/ /zhes gangs sman dang /

mtsho sman gnyis lhan cig tu gsol mchod bya tshul 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar zhing / 'di dag gi gsol mchod mngon rtogs sogs la rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung gi zin so dang / bon rdzun mas sbyar ba'i gzhung nas bshad pa ma mthong yang bla ma gong ma'i thugs rtsis can gyi gzhi rnams la bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gzhan gyi'ang so sor dag snang ma lta bu'i gsol mchod bka' rtsom mang du mthong zhing nged rang ni nyon mongs pa'i 'dam du bying bas dag snang 'char ba'i go skabs ci la srid kyang / tshe 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa du ma thob pas des na 'di pa'i lugs la zhen pas zhugs na 'bras mi bslu ba'i lam zhes gsungs pa zhig gda' bas gangs dang mtsho la gnas pa'i sman mo gnyis kyi sku mdog ni gnas skabs gti mug dang / zhe sdang ma spangs dag pa'i rang bzhin la sbyar zhing / phyag mtshan ni dgos 'dod stsol ba la sbyar la/ gsol mchod 'bul tshul ni/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro don mdzad pa la sbyar bas gzhi dus kyi 'khrul snang de nyid lam dus su dge ba'i rtsis zin par byas pas gnas skabs kyi bde skyid dang / mthar thug rten 'brel 'grig la 'bras dus su don ma lus pa mngon du 'gyur bas na lugs 'di ni bstan chos ngan pa 'don pa'i ngag dang cung mi 'dra'am snyam pas shes ldan gzur gnas rnams kyis dpyad par zhu/ yi ge pa ni bkra shis rgyal mtshan no/ /bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bla ri dang bla mtsho sman rgyal ma gnyis la gsol mchod bya tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
